pages.text: Processing and obtaining metal works a bit differently in this world. Metal, or rather scrap metal, can initially be obtained from underground pipes if you have a flimsy pickaxe. Later, you can get it from most furniture if you have a better pickaxe. I couldn't find the right kind of stone in this world, so I replaced it with concrete. In the end, I made a concrete furnace out of concrete bricks (I'll write down the recipes for both).
Having fuel, a concrete furnace, and scrap metal, you can get molten metal, which can then be used with acid.
